description: CT-21 invariant requires SecretRef construction to validate opacity as an invalid-input refusal (a reference 'never encoding venue, broker, account, environment, or key material; construction validates opacity as an invalid-input refusal'). qmf-core SecretRef.try_create validates only non-emptiness, so a reference that plainly encodes structured deployment data is accepted. The type lives in qmf-core but is the CT-21 opacity gate qmf-venue's AccountBinding.try_create delegates to ('a non-opaque reference is refused at SecretRef.try_create'), so the venue delegation is hollow. Failed for all 3 structured inputs. Caveat: fully detecting that an opaque string 'encodes' account data is hard in general, but the code enforces zero opacity checks.
expected: SecretRef.try_create of a plainly-structured reference (e.g. 'venue=cTrader;broker=Pepperstone;account=1234567;env=live;key=SUPERSECRETAPIKEY') returns an invalid-input TypedRefusal.
observed: SecretRef.try_create returns Ok(SecretRef(...)) — the structured reference is accepted verbatim; only a blank string is refused.

description: The qmf-venue distribution unit ships no FAILURES.md failure register, although every other roster package (qmf-core, qmf-data, qmf-indicators, qmf-registry, qmf-structure) ships one under the conventions/failure-register.md convention and NFR-11 requires every designed failure mode to ship a register entry. The six typed-refusal categories reachable at the venue boundary (invalid-input, unsupported-capability, unavailable-dependency, policy-rejection, transient-venue-failure, storage-failure) have no register entry stating class, detection, recovery semantics, degraded state, notification tier, and product-user affordance. Confirms plan finding F-E08-001.
expected: packages/qmf-venue/FAILURES.md exists and documents every venue-boundary typed refusal category.
observed: packages/qmf-venue/FAILURES.md does not exist (ls packages/qmf-venue/ -> pyproject.toml README.md src tests).
